current.text: He has a torn ACL and is out. Yahoo lists him as out with a knee injury.
He is expected to miss big chunks of the season and should return near the end of his rookie season.
He is a rookie in his first NBA season.
In dynasty rookie rankings he dropped to 36th because he is an older player who will miss his first year.
Memphis has a crowded guard group with Ty Jerome, Javon Small, Scotty Pippen Jr., Campazzo and Cam Spencer. Coach Tuomas Iisalo uses an 11-man rotation and keeps minutes down.
Even after he returns, the crowded guard group and short rotation stints make real fantasy minutes unlikely this season. He is not a draft target in our league.

durable.text: He is an older prospect from BYU and a shooter.
